recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Future schema-validity findings should be handled as separate issues unless they specifically reintroduce the FHIR-19107 AdministrativeGender duplicate-component defect.
issue_request: FHIR-19107 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core STU3 correction for fhir-all-xsd.zip, reporting duplicate global components named AdministrativeGender-list and AdministrativeGender in the XML schemas linked from FHIR-core downloads.
initial_application: No local git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-19107. The likely historical application is the October 2018 FixSchemas work, especially 80c59ae7c185d9fe5d5d8f79a2043cdeaf91aa13, merged by f096c85630b7223b496ea1f78c897eec3ad94dae as PR #94, which removed a local AdministrativeGender binding declaration row from the then ObservationDefinition spreadsheet while preserving the element's AdministrativeGender use.
additional_context: The current repository keeps source/fhir-all.xsd and tools/schema/fhir-all.xsd as build templates rather than checked-in generated validation schema downloads. ObservationDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, and its current StructureDefinition has one required AdministrativeGender binding for sexParameterForClinicalUse. The current build.fhir.org fhir-all-xsd.zip has one AdministrativeGender complexType and one AdministrativeGenderEnum simpleType in fhir-single.xsd and fhir-base.xsd, no AdministrativeGender-list component, and no duplicate same-kind global component names in those combined/base schema files.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The seed defect was already corrected historically, and the current editable source plus current generated validation schema surface do not contain the duplicate AdministrativeGender components reported by the Jira.
